ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$3.38 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (metered over-distance on the unexplained deviation), and record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: read the chat (pickup logistics only), the complaint and the driver's statement — nothing threatening, abusive, sexual or dangerous; the accident is the driver's explanation, not an allegation against anyone. No escalated safety concern.

Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra kilometres do reach the fare (RD-2 metered branch). Comparison: trace = 76 legs at 30 s; Σ speed×time = 17.51 km in 33.75 min vs quoted route 17.154 km / 23.6 min, meter 22.25 km / 33.75 min. Time and distance both reconcile (driver did not pad distance by doubling back), so the whole overrun is the route driven. The trace leaves the quoted corridor well before the accident zone (Woodlands Ave 7, around (1.4276,103.7965), inside the detour window) and rejoins it after Tampines Ave 10 at ~17:59:10 — i.e. the driver bypassed the SELETAR EXPRESSWAY stretch that carries the LTA Accident. Because he left the SES before reaching the incident location, the incident did not compel that departure (RD-4(a) not satisfied); no other incident or band ≤ 2 applies to the departed corridor, so the detour is unexempt under RD-1 and there is no chat consent, only the driver's unrecorded explanation (RD-5, G11). Extra distance: 22.25 − 17.154 = 5.096 km → well above the meter's normal unit accumulation; the 800 m of unmapped corridor (SELETAR/TAMPINES EXPRESSWAY link geometry stops at 103.854) plus mapping jitter accounts for roughly 1.7 km, leaving ~3.4–3.5 km attributable to the bypass. Unit rate = distance_fare ÷ distance_km = 31.37 ÷ 22.25 = S$1.4099/km. Refund = 2.4 km (conservative, under-credited deviation) × 1.4099 = S$3.38. Confidence lowered because per-segment km are approximated from a 30 s-thinned trace and the residual baseline is estimated rather than given as facts.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment from ~17:31 (Woodlands Ave 7 / (1.4276,103.7965)) to ~17:59 (Tampines Ave 10), bypassing the Seletar Expressway stretch. No rider consent in chat and no routing request (RD-5; a verbal agreement asserted in the driver statement is not consent, G11). The LTA Accident on Seletar Expressway (reported 17:16) sits inside that bypassed corridor, so it does not qualify as reasonable cause under RD-4(a): the driver left the SES before reaching the incident point. Unjustified deviation under RD-1 → extra km refunded under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 requires the traffic incident to justify the replaced segment; the record shows the driver departed the SELETAR EXPRESSWAY before the accident location, so the incident did not compel the deviation.
No rider message agrees to any route change in the chat; consent must be the rider's own pre-detour message (RD-5, G11).

ruling.evidence_gap: No per-segment extra_km facts supplied; segment distances were computed from the 30 s-thinned GPS trace and capped conservatively. The LTA link geometry covers only part of the quoted corridor, so the 800 m of expressway inside the corridor could not be matched.
